headline: AyalaLand Logistics sells Laguna data center to ePLDT
summary: AyalaLand Logistics is selling its stake in the A-FLOW data center in Laguna to ePLDT, the ICT arm of PLDT. A memorandum of agreement was disclosed on November 20.
why: AyalaLand Logistics is a Philippine property developer focused on industrial parks and warehouses. ePLDT is the information and communications technology arm of PLDT, the country's major telecom group.
